changes: Updated docs/requirements/decisions/stash-split-execution-plan.md so each accepted stash bucket must become a separate future Lattice story with tests and evidence. Removed the direct story-or-commit bypass wording; NAV was intentionally unchanged.
usage: Use the stash split plan as before, but now every accepted bucket must start as its own Lattice story before restoration, testing, review, validation, and commit inside that story.
expectedOutcome: User sees the final audit result: the only real blocker was fixed, and the stash split plan is now explicitly story-gated while the rest of the executable safeguards still pass.
actualTranscript: lattice validate --story=B-ee33 --json returned status pass, allPass true, npm test pass, cli-e2e ALL PASS, and verification intent coverage 6/6. Delivery reviewer verified three document promises and two real-machine tests.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match. Only the direct commit bypass wording changed; NAV and stash execution mechanics stayed unchanged.
limitations: This story only fixes the verified wording/process correctness issue. It does not execute, restore, drop, or process any stash bucket.
pitfalls: Owner lease had to be continued with the recorded KOALA_SESSION_ID because the active story lease was owned by an earlier derived session in the same worktree. Worktree dependencies were missing, so ignored node_modules symlink and npm run build were used before validate.
